chunks.arabic_text: وَ رَوَى زُرْعَةُ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ:

translations.en: And Zur'ah narrated from Sama'ah, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَدْخَلَ جَارِيَةً يَتَمَتَّعُ بِهَا ثُمَّ أُنْسِيَ حَتَّى وَاقَعَهَا هَلْ يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ حَدُّ الزَّانِي

translations.en: I asked him about a man who took a bondwoman for temporary marriage, then it was forgotten until he had intercourse with her. Is the hadd punishment of a fornicator incumbent upon him?

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ «لَا وَ لَكِنْ يَتَمَتَّعُ بِهَا بَعْدَ النِّكَاحِ وَ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ مِمَّا أَتَى».

translations.en: He said: "No. Rather, he should contract temporary marriage with her after the nikah and seek forgiveness from Allah for what he has done."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a man who had intercourse with a bondwoman intended for temporary marriage before the proper nikah was completed due to forgetfulness. The Imam عليه السلام states that the hadd of zina does not apply in this case, but the man must regularize the relationship through nikah and seek forgiveness from Allah.
en.seo_question: Does the hadd punishment apply if someone had intercourse before completing temporary marriage out of forgetfulness?

key_terms.يَتَمَتَّعُ بِهَا: to enter into temporary marriage with her
key_terms.حَدُّ الزَّانِي: the prescribed punishment of a fornicator
